name: index statistics are an open map
description: data is the backend's own vocabulary, not this service's: Elasticsearch reports queries/documents/deleted/storage_bytes, Meilisearch reports documents/indexing. Only "documents" is pinned here, because it is the one key both produce; asserting the Elasticsearch half would make this fixture unrunnable against a Meilisearch deployment. storage_bytes is the single snake_case name on this wire — it predates the monorepo and Phorge's cluster panel reads it by that spelling, so renaming it to storageBytes blanks a column with no error anywhere. That one is pinned in the Go tests instead.
